study-a.pdf: Synthetic study A describes a vision classifier evaluated on daytime road images.
Study A used mean average precision at IoU 0.50 (mAP50) as its primary evaluation metric. The held-out dataset contained 240 daytime images.
Study A used an encoder with two attention layers and a patch embedding.
study-b.pdf: Synthetic study B explored an object detector on nighttime intersections.
Study B trained using AdamW with an initial learning rate of 0.0003.
Study B reported average precision at IoU 0.75 (AP75). Its held-out dataset contained 180 nighttime images.
